# Curate reference genome data
```{r}
samples <- read_tsv("./scripts/CoverageStats_shared_scripts/sample_NG_pilot.tsv") %>% .$sample_id

summary_statistics <- lapply(samples,FUN=function(x){ 
  read_tsv(paste0("./data/reference_genome_coverage/coverage/reference_genome_coverage/",x,"/gatk/",x,"_CoverageStats_summary.txt"))
}) %>% do.call(rbind,.) %>% mutate(reference_location = 'Neisseria gonorrhoeae FA 1090')

summary_statistics$genotype <- 'Neisseria gonorrhoeae FA 1090 chromosome'

saveRDS(summary_statistics,"./data/reference_genome_coverage/coverage/curated_datasets/FA1090_genome_coverage_summary_statistics.RDS")
```
